# US-018 — Provisional illustrations generated by code

- **Epic**: EPIC-05
- **Status**: Done
- **Priority**: Should
- **Size**: M
- **Branch**: `us-018-illustrations-provisoires`

## Story

As a **player on the integration team**, I want **every card to already have a simple, coherent illustration** so that
**I can recognise the cards at a glance without waiting for an image generator to be chosen**.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] **When** I run `npm run illustrations:provisoires`, **then** the 71 cards of set 1 each receive a vector original
      rendered as a 4:3 PNG, described in `set-1.json`, then produced by the US-015 pipeline.
- [x] The drawing follows the [art direction](../../produit/direction-artistique.md): midnight-blue background, family
      palette and emblem, no text, letter, digit or logo; **rarity** reads through intensity (halo, rings, sparks) and
      **type** through a secondary motif (spell, incident, evolution).
- [x] Two cards of the same family, type and rarity remain **distinct** (variations drawn from the card number), and a
      card **always** gives the same image (deterministic generator).
- [x] Each card has alternative text; each served file weighs less than 100 KB (EPIC-05 indicator).
- [x] The images are versioned: the generator is the source of truth, no original to archive.
- [x] `npm run check`, `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` pass, with no axe-core violation.

## Notes

- Decision: [ADR 0016](../../decisions/0016-illustrations-provisoires-vectorielles.md). On 2026-10-18 the project owner
  asked for simple images made by Claude "for the time being", while waiting to settle the Recraft plan (US-016).
- The images of the Recraft trial (US-016) stay outside the repository: they belong to Recraft.
- When real illustrations arrive (US-017), they will replace these card by card, through the same pipeline.

## Log

- 2026-10-18 — created.
- 2026-10-18 — generator `packages/illustrations/src/vectoriel/`: 8 family emblems drawn in SVG (drop shadow,
  gradient, light details), midnight-blue background and family glow, star field and constellation specific to the
  card, base, motif per type (satellites according to cost, chevrons, rune circle, cracks and AI "glitch"), intensity
  per rarity (ring, double ring, golden halo and sparks); deterministic randomness drawn from the number.
  `npm run illustrations:provisoires` draws the 71 cards in about 30 s and chains the US-015 pipeline: 284 files of 3
  to 14 KB (2.5 MB). 7 generator tests; check, build and 18 e2e journeys green. **Limitation**: two cards of the same
  family, type and rarity remain close (orientation, satellites, constellation); this is provisional, to be replaced
  by real illustrations (US-017). In review.
- 2026-10-18 — delivered: provisional illustrations of the 71 cards generated by code, merged by PR #12
